acquisition: guided local-floor perimeter; explicit corner/refine/wall RGB keyframes; live wall-view guidance from XR pose; same XRView raw camera; CPU depth optional
processing: confirmed floor polygon -> constrained Deep wall/object classification -> textured room shell + persistent non-structural RGB point clouds grouped in oriented bounding boxes (OBB)
viewer: orthographic/isometric CPU viewer; textured shell; selectable OBB object manager; per-object hide/remove/restore; bare-room mode
nonLambertian: depth behind confirmed shell is isolated as opening/optical evidence and never allowed to deform the room shell
liveHeavyProcessing: disabled during WebXR: no Deep inference, no TSDF structural fusion, no plane/mesh structural inference
cachePolicy: V12.2.2 service worker; HTML/worker/build-info network-first; ONNX/WASM on-demand cache
objects: non-structural residual = connected voxel components -> gravity-aligned PCA OBB + compact RGB point cloud; OBB proxy only in OBJ, detailed residual in PLY
